# Test cases for ci/sast/nulavio-rules.yml (generic rules: shell, CI, container,
# packaging and Gradle lines); not a script, never run.
# A line annotated "ruleid" must match the rule named, a line annotated "ok" must not.
#   scripts/security/scan.sh opengrep-rules

# --- nulavio-verification-bypass

# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
curl -fsSLk -o tool.tar.gz https://example.org/tool.tar.gz
# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
curl --insecure https://example.org/tool.tar.gz
# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
curl -fsSL https://example.org/install.sh | sh
# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
wget -qO- https://example.org/install.sh | sudo bash
# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
wget --no-check-certificate https://example.org/tool.tar.gz
# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
git -c http.sslVerify=false clone https://example.org/repo.git
# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
export GIT_SSL_NO_VERIFY=1
# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
gpgcheck=0
# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
dnf install -y --nogpgcheck tool
# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
deb [trusted=yes] https://example.org/apt stable main
# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
apt-get install -y --allow-unauthenticated tool
# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
rpm -i --nosignature tool.rpm
# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
pip install --trusted-host example.org tool
# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
python3 -m pip install ruff
# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
./gradlew build --dependency-verification=off
# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
RUN curl -fsSL -o /tmp/tool.tar.gz \
    --insecure https://example.org/tool.tar.gz
# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
curl -fsSL https://example.org/install.sh \
    | bash
# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
curl -fsSL https://example.org/install.sh | \
    sudo sh
# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
./gradlew -F off build
# ruleid: nulavio-verification-bypass
android/gradlew -p android --no-daemon -F=lenient :app:assembleRelease
# ok: nulavio-verification-bypass
curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -o tool.tar.gz https://example.org/tool.tar.gz
# ok: nulavio-verification-bypass
gpgcheck=1
# ok: nulavio-verification-bypass
deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/example.gpg] https://example.org/apt stable main
# ok: nulavio-verification-bypass
.venv/bin/pip install --require-hashes -r requirements/dev.txt
# ok: nulavio-verification-bypass
./gradlew build --dependency-verification=strict
# ok: nulavio-verification-bypass
./gradlew -F strict build
# ok: nulavio-verification-bypass
grep -F off notes.txt
# ok: nulavio-verification-bypass
RUN curl -fsSL -o /tmp/t.tgz https://example.org/t.tgz && \
    du -sk /tmp/t.tgz
# ok: nulavio-verification-bypass
RUN curl -fsSL --proto '=https' -o /tmp/t.tgz https://example.org/t.tgz \
    && tar -xkf /tmp/t.tgz -C /opt
# ok: nulavio-verification-bypass
./gradlew build && \
    grep -F off notes.txt
# ok: nulavio-verification-bypass
curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -o tool.tar.gz \
    https://example.org/tool.tar.gz
tar -xkf tool.tar.gz

# --- nulavio-ci-writes-gradle-verification

# ruleid: nulavio-ci-writes-gradle-verification
android/gradlew -p android --no-daemon --write-verification-metadata sha256 :app:assembleRelease
# ruleid: nulavio-ci-writes-gradle-verification
./gradlew -M sha256,pgp help
# ok: nulavio-ci-writes-gradle-verification
android/gradlew -p android --no-daemon -q :app:lintDebug :app:assembleRelease

# --- nulavio-sh-secret-in-argv

# ruleid: nulavio-sh-secret-in-argv
gpg --batch --passphrase "$PASSPHRASE" --sign SHA256SUMS
# ruleid: nulavio-sh-secret-in-argv
tool login --token=$TOKEN
# ruleid: nulavio-sh-secret-in-argv
sshpass -p "$PW" ssh host
# ok: nulavio-sh-secret-in-argv
gpg --batch --passphrase-fd 3 --sign SHA256SUMS 3<"$passphrase_file"
# ok: nulavio-sh-secret-in-argv
gpg --batch --pinentry-mode loopback --passphrase '' --quick-gen-key test
# ok: nulavio-sh-secret-in-argv
tool login --token-file "$token_file"
